title: About
text:
Hi, I’m Joey. I’m a freshman at Northwestern studying Applied Math and Mathematical Methods in the Social Sciences (MMSS).
All my code is on GitHub, so you can check my work.

title: Welcome!
text:
This is a blog about the beautiful game of baseball and the numbers behind it. I’m Joey, a freshman at Northwestern studying math, and I’m starting this to get some more practice working with real baseball data and to write about anything interesting I find.
Posts will mostly be short: a question, a chart, and what I think it shows. The code will be on GitHub so you can check my work.
More to come soon, so stay tuned.
